name: Ratch Group Public Company Limited
summary: Ratch Group Public Company Limited, an energy and infrastructure company, engages in the generation and sales of electricity and steam in Thailand, Australia, Singapore, Indonesia, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Domestic Electricity Generating, Domestic Renewable Energy, International Power Projects, and Domestic Related Business and Infrastructure. It generates electricity through natural gas, coal, and fuel oil, as well as invests in renewable power generation including solar, wind, biomass and hydro power.
